text:
```yaml
name: Devin on Label

on:
  issues:
    types: [labeled]

jobs:
  devin-session:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install -g jq

      - name: Get issue details
        id: get-issue-details
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=title::$(jq -r '.issue.title' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)"
          echo "::set-output name=url::$(jq -r '.repository.html_url' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)/issues/$(jq -r '.issue.number' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)"

      - name: Create Devin session
        env:
          DEVIN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_API_KEY }}
          ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ steps.get-issue-details.outputs.title }}
          ISSUE_URL: ${{ steps.get-issue-details.outputs.url }}
        run: |
          SESSION_URL=$(curl -s -X POST "https://api.devin.ai/v1/sessions" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEVIN_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"prompt\":\"Issue Title: $ISSUE_TITLE\\nIssue URL: $ISSUE_URL\\n$ISSUE_BODY\"}" | jq -r '.url')
          echo "::set-env name=SESSION_URL::$SESSION_URL"

      - name: Comment on issue with session link
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          SESSION_URL: ${{ env.SESSION_URL }}
        run: |
          echo "Creating Devin session: $SESSION_URL"
          echo "View the session here: <https://devin.ai/$SESSION_URL>" >> $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/comment.md
          gh issue comment ${{ github.event.issue.number }} --file $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/comment.md
```
